streamPreview:
## comparison

### 1. 产品定位

| 维度 | OpenClaw | WorkBuddy |
|---|---|---|
| 一句话定义 | 自托管的多通道 AI Agent 网关，让你在任意聊天 App 里使唤 AI | 腾讯出品的办公 AI Agent，多智能体协作完成复杂办公任务 |
| 目标用户 | 开发者 / 高级个人用户 | 办公职场人士 |
| 核心理念 | **用你已有的聊天工具**（WhatsApp/Telegram/Discord 等）作为 AI 入口 | **端到端替你产出办公交付物**（报告/PPT/表格），结果可验证 |
| 组织背景 | OpenClaw Foundation 非营利组织，MIT 开源 | 腾讯，商业产品 |

### 2. 部署与运行方式

| 维度 | OpenClaw | WorkBuddy |
|---|---|---|
| 部署模型 | **自托管**（自己的机器或服务器），一个 Gateway 进程 | **云端 SaaS**（[inference] 基于腾讯云），无需自部署 |
| 运行环境 | Node 24.15+（亦兼容 22 LTS / 25.9+），macOS/Linux/Windows | 浏览器访问，无本地依赖 |
| 安装方式 | `npm i -g openclaw` 或一键 curl 脚本 | 网页端直接使用 |
| 客户端 | CLI + Web Control UI + macOS/Windows/iOS/Android 原生 App | Web 端为主 |

### 3. 核心能力

| 维度 | OpenClaw | WorkBuddy |
|---|---|---|
| 通道接入 | Discord, WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, Slack, iMessage, Google Chat, Matrix, MS Teams, Zalo 等 10+ 通道 + 插件扩展 | 自有界面，不通过第三方 IM |
| 多渠道同时在线 | ✅ 一个 Gateway 同时服务所有配置的通道 | N/A |
| 多智能体 | ✅ 按会话/发送者/工作区隔离，各自独立的 sandbox 和 tool policy | ✅ 多 Agent 协作分解复杂任务 |
| Sandbox | ✅ 三种模式（off/non-main/all），三种 scope（agent/session/shared），Docker 隔离 | [inference] 云端隔离 |
| 工具/技能 | **100+ 内置技能**（KDnuggets），含浏览器操作、文件系统、Shell 执行、cron、webhooks | 办公场景工具：报告生成、PPT 制作、表格处理 |
| 产出物类型 | 真实世界动作（发邮件、管日历、值机）+ 代码/文件操作 | **结构化办公文档**（报告/PPT/表格），强调"可验证" |
| 媒体支持 | 图片/音频/文档收发 | [unknown] |
| LLM 提供商 | 多提供商，支持 failover | [unknown] |
| 插件市场 | ClawHub 插件市场 | [unknown] |

### 4. 安全与权限模型

| 维度 | OpenClaw | WorkBuddy |
|---|---|---|
| 通道级安全 | token、allowlist、mention 规则、access groups | [unknown] |
| Agent 级工具策略 | **8 层递进过滤**（profile → provider → global → agent → sandbox → subagent），只收不扩 | [unknown] |
| 数据主权 | 数据留在自己机器 | 数据在腾讯云 |

### 5. 商业模式与生态

| 维度 | OpenClaw | WorkBuddy |
|---|---|---|
| 许可 | MIT 开源 | 商业闭源 |
| 价格 | 免费（自付 LLM API 费 + 机器成本） | [unknown] |
| 社区 | GitHub 开源社区，Discord | 腾讯 CodeBuddy 生态体系 |
| 生态集成 | 通过聊天 App 覆盖所有场景 | 腾讯办公生态（[inference] 可能与腾讯文档/企业微信等联动） |

## verdict

**本质不同，不构成替代关系。**

- **OpenClaw** 是一个 **AI Agent 基础设施**——它解决的是"怎么让 AI 随时随地触达你"的问题。核心价值在于自托管的数据主权 + 多通道统一入口 + 灵活的 Agent 路由与 sandbox 隔离。适合需要在自己硬件上跑、通过现有 IM 工具交互的技术用户。
- **WorkBuddy** 是一个 **办公场景的 AI 应用**——它解决的是"怎么让 AI 替你产出可交付的办公文档"的问题。核心价值在于多 Agent 协作分解任务 + 结构化输出（报告/PPT/表格）可直接用于工作流。

如果你是开发者想给团队搭一个自托管的 AI 助理基础设施，选 OpenClaw。如果是普通办公人员想要 AI 帮忙写报告做 PPT，选 WorkBuddy。一个在基础设施层，一个在应用层。

## open_questions

- WorkBuddy 支持哪些 LLM 后端，是否可自选模型
- WorkBuddy 的定价模式（免费/付费/企业版）
- WorkBuddy 是否与腾讯文档、企业微信等腾讯系产品深度打通
- WorkBuddy 的"多 Agent 协作"具体机制是什么（任务分配策略、Agent 间通信协议）
- OpenClaw 的"100+ skills"具体涵盖哪些类别，与 oh-my-pi 的 25+ tools 有何重叠与互补
- WorkBuddy 是否支持自托管/私有化部署

## assumptions

- WorkBuddy 为云端 SaaS 产品，不支持自托管——基于其官网为纯前端 React SPA、无安装指引 [inference]
- WorkBuddy 的"可验证输出"指的是产出物附带来源引用/中间步骤可审计——基于官网描述推断 [inference]
- WorkBuddy 底层与腾讯 CodeBuddy 共享技术栈——基于域名 codebuddy.cn/work 和工作品牌关联 [inference]

- claim: "OpenClaw offers multi-agent routing with isolated sessions and per-agent sandbox/tool policies" | url: https://docs2.openclaw.ai/tools/multi-agent-sandbox-tools | relevance: 多 Agent 配置与策略文档
- claim: "OpenClaw has 100+ built-in skills connecting AI to apps, browsers, and system tools" | url: https://www.kdnuggets.com/openclaw-explained-the-free-ai-agent-tool-going-viral-already-in-2026 | relevance: KDnuggets 评测文章
- claim: "OpenClaw is MIT licensed, developed by OpenClaw Foundation" | url: https://docs.openclaw.ai/ | relevance: 许可证与组织信息
- claim: "WorkBuddy is Tencent's AI Agent for office work, powered by multi-agent collaboration" | url: https://www.workbuddy.ai/ | relevance: 官网 meta description 定义产品定位
- claim: "WorkBuddy delivers finished, verifiable outputs — reports, decks, spreadsheets" | url: https://www.workbuddy.ai/ | relevance: 官网描述核心产出物类型
- claim: "OpenClaw runs on macOS, Linux, Windows with Node 24.15+" | u

Troubleshooting, FAQs, testing, diagnostics, and environment checks. ## What is OpenClaw? OpenClaw is a **self-hosted gateway** that connects your favorite chat apps — Discord, Google Chat, iMessage, Matrix, Microsoft Teams, Signal, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, Zalo, and more via channel plugins — to AI coding agents. You run a single Gateway process on your own machine (or a server), and it becomes the bridge between your messaging apps and an always-available AI assistant. **Who is it for?** Developers and power users who want a personal AI assistant they can message from anywhere — without giving up control of their data or relying on a hosted service. **What makes it different?** - **Self-hosted**: runs on your hardware, your rules - **Multi-channel**: one Gateway serves every configured channel plugin simultaneously - **Agent-native**: built for coding agents with tool use, sessions, memory, and multi-agent routing - **Open source**: MIT licensed, community-driven **What do you need?** Node 24.15+ (recommended), Node 22 LTS (`22.22.3+`) for compatibility, or Node 25.9+, an API key from your chosen provider, and 5 minutes. For best quality and security, use the strongest latest-generation model available. ## How it works ```mermaid flowchart LR A["Chat apps + plugins"] --> B["Gateway"] B --> C["OpenClaw agent"] B --> D["CLI"] B --> E["Web Control UI"] B --> F["macOS app"] B --> G["iOS and Android nodes"] ``` The Gateway is the single source of truth for sessions, routing, and channel connections. ## Key capabilities Discord, iMessage, Signal, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, WebChat, and more with a single Gateway process. Channel plugins add Matrix, Nostr, Twitch, Zalo, and more; official plugins install on demand. Isolated sessions per agent, workspace, or sender. Send and receive images, audio, and documents. Browser dashboard for chat, config, sessions, and nodes. Pair iOS and Android nodes for Canvas, camera, and voice-enabled workflows. ## Quick start ```bash npm install -g openclaw@latest ``` ```bash openclaw onboard --install-daemon ``` Open the Control UI in your browser and send a message: ```bash openclaw dashboard ``` Or connect a channel ([Telegram](/channels/telegram) is fastest) and chat from your phone. Need the full install and dev setup? See [Getting Started](/start/getting-started). ## Dashboard Open the browser Control UI after the Gateway starts. - Local default: [http://127.0.0.1:18789/](http://127.0.0.1:18789/) - Remote access: [Web surfaces](/web) and [Tailscale](/gateway/tailscale)

## Configuration (optional) Config lives at `~/.openclaw/openclaw.json`. - If you **do nothing**, OpenClaw uses the bundled OpenClaw agent runtime; DMs share the agent's main session, and each group chat gets its own session. - If you want to lock it down, start with `channels.whatsapp.allowFrom` and (for groups) mention rules. Example: ```json5 { channels: { whatsapp: { allowFrom: ["+15555550123"], groups: { "*": { requireMention: true } }, }, }, messages: { groupChat: { mentionPatterns: ["@openclaw"] } }, } ``` ## Start here All docs and guides, organized by use case. Core Gateway settings, tokens, and provider config. SSH and tailnet access patterns. Channel-specific setup for Discord, Feishu, Microsoft Teams, Telegram, WhatsApp, and more. iOS and Android nodes with pairing, Canvas, camera, and device actions. Common fixes and troubleshooting entry point. ## Learn more Complete channel, routing, and media capabilities. Workspace isolation and per-agent sessions. Tokens, allowlists, and safety controls. Gateway diagnostics and common errors. Project origins, contributors, and license. `agents.entries.*.tools.sandbox.tools`. `tools.subagents.tools`, if applicable. * Each level can further restrict tools, but cannot grant back denied tools from earlier levels. * If tool keys accept either `provider` (e.g. `google-antigravity`) or `provider/model` (e.g. `openai/gpt-5.4`). If any explicit allowlist in that chain leaves the run with no callable tools, OpenClaw stops before submitting the prompt to the model.
